status.description: Status is the current status of the Volume.

Volume.title: Volume
Volume.description: Volume is a persistent storage device that lives inside a Space and that is mounted by the Workspaces of that Space at arbitrary paths. Unlike the Workspace's own private storage, a Volume has a lifecycle of its own (i.e. it outlives the Workspaces that mount it), it is shared between the Members of its Space and it is never included in the WorkspaceSnapshots of the Workspaces that mount it. Volumes are backed by a Kubernetes persistent volume and, therefore, they belong to a single Region and can only be mounted by the Workspaces that run in that same Region.

size.description: Size is the requested capacity of the Volume. It defaults to the Cluster's default Volume size. It can later be grown but never shrunk and growing it additionally requires the storage backend to support the expansion of the already provisioned volumes.

accessMode.title: Access Mode
accessMode.description: AccessMode is the concurrency guarantee of a Volume

megabytes.description: Megabytes is the capacity in megabytes.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Spec.title: Size
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Spec.description: Size is the capacity of a Volume.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the Volume's lifecycle

spaceRef.description: SpaceRef is the reference of the Space that owns the Volume.

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the Octelium User who created the Volume.

regionRef.description: RegionRef is the reference of the Region that hosts the Volume's underlying storage. Only the Workspaces that run in that Region can mount the Volume.

capacity.description: Capacity is the actual capacity of the provisioned storage as it is reported by the storage backend. It is unset until the Volume is provisioned and it can be larger than the requested size.

readyAt.description: ReadyAt is the timestamp at which the Volume's storage was provisioned.

failure.description: Failure is the reason of the failure of the Volume, if any.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.title: Status
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.description: Status is the current status of the Volume. It is entirely managed by the Cluster and it is read-only.

message.description: Message is a human-readable description of the failure.

unsupported.description: Unsupported means that the Cluster cannot provision the Volume as it is requested.

storage.description: Storage means that the storage backend failed.

unknown.description: Unknown means that the Volume failed for an unclassified reason.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.title: Failure
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.description: Failure describes the reason of the failure of a Volume.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.title: Storage
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.description: Storage means that the storage backend failed to provision the Volume or that the already provisioned storage was lost.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.title: Unknown
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.description: Unknown means that the Volume failed for an unclassified reason.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.title: Unsupported
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Volume.Stat.description: Unsupported means that the Cluster is not able to provision the Volume as it is requested (e.g. a SHARED Volume was requested while no multi-writer storage backend is configured).

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
